audit.why: Twitch is weak and range-starved before he stacks Deadly Venom; he flips at 6 via Ambush repositioning and hard at first item once Runaan's/crit turns his R and E into real shred/burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); the true-damage/on-hit nature of Deadly Venom (missingInteractions) wasn't stated, so 'itemize armor' would read as reasonable advice when it isn't.
audit.why: Ambush is a flat 16s CD, Venom Cask goes 13s to 9s, and his passive ignores resistances entirely and scales with attack speed — armor/MR investment doesn't answer it.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns and folded the resistances-invalidated point into breakdown.late; folded onhit-itemization into dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Twitch Ambush (Stealth): matchup-defining — The stealth approach starts every Twitch fight — sweep the flanks and track the disappearance. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Beat Drop like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ambush (Stealth) is down 16s flat — sweep the flank the moment he vanishes and track the return. - Venom Cask (W) resets from 13s to 9s at max rank — respect the poison timer. - Guard your own E Beat Drop like a fifth summoner spell; R only on kill windows.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: W shields, then heals once already shielded — cast it before he steps up so both procs land before his auto trade does.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: His on-hit passive scales with attack speed, not burst — standing forward just feeds him more procs off you.

edits.before: You conduct: R through your front line into theirs, echo the heals, and root the charmed remainder.
edits.after: You conduct: R through their line — his venom ignores armor, so root the remainder and echo the heals.
